description: The knowledge-graph schema for the Corvane Instruments corpus. The same file builds the extraction prompt, the structured-output JSON schema, the validation rules and the text-to-Cypher prompt.

entities.Person: A named employee or contact, e.g. a team lead or account manager.
entities.Team: An internal team, e.g. the Firmware team.
entities.Service: Software Corvane runs, e.g. a cloud service or web dashboard.
entities.Product: A device Corvane sells to customers.
entities.Component: A part that goes into a product, e.g. a chip, module, cell or enclosure.
entities.Company: An outside company that is not a customer, e.g. a supplier or a logistics provider.
entities.Customer: An organisation that buys or uses Corvane products.
entities.Site: A plant or building where products are made.
entities.Incident: A named problem or outage that has an incident review.

LEADS.description: The person leads the team or manages the site.

MEMBER_OF.description: The person works in the team.

MANAGES_ACCOUNT.description: The person is the account manager for the customer.

OWNS.description: The team owns the service or the product design.

CONNECTS_VIA.description: The product sends data or receives updates through the service.

READS_FROM.description: The service reads data from another service.

PART_OF.description: The component goes into the product.

SUPPLIES.description: The company makes or supplies the component.

REPLACES.description: The first component replaces the second.

USES.description: The customer runs, ordered or uses the product.

ASSEMBLED_AT.description: The product is assembled or built at the site.

AFFECTED.description: The incident affected the component, product, service or customer.

INVOLVES.description: The incident involved the company or team, e.g. the supplier that caused it.

properties.since: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the fact holds, when the text gives one.
properties.until: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) until which the fact held, when the text gives one.
properties.role: For SUPPLIES: 'sole', 'main' or 'second source', when the text says so.
properties.units: For USES: the number of units, when the text gives one.
properties.date: An ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the incident, when the text gives one.
